Name: Planneric
Author: Synthicated
Description:
[b][size=4][Description]:[/size][/b]
This mod lets you display your location layout right inside the game! It’s super handy not having to switch between the planner tab and the game, right?
[list]
[*]Press [b]L[/b] to enter layout save mode. Select an area and confirm to save.[/*]
[*]Press [b]R[/b] to show the layout.[/*]
[*]Press [b]PageUp[/b]/[b]PageDown[/b] to switch between layouts, or use the arrows on the widget in the top-left.[/*]
[*]Move your layout with the arrow keys.[/*]
[*]Don’t like the default hotkeys or is the layout too (in-)transparent? Customize everything via GenericModConfigMenu (GMCM)![/*]
[/list][center][b][img]https://i.ibb.co/WvhKJXYt/output-trimmed.gif[/img][/b]
[size=1]ayo-so-cool-demo.gif[/size][/center]

[b][size=4][Questions]: [/size][/b]
Q: Where are my layouts?
- For now, layouts are saved/loaded only in the [b]layouts[/b] folder (inside the mod folder).
I’ll add an option to choose a custom location for layouts.
Q: The game crashed while I was playing with your mod, what should I do?
- Report it as a bug in the mod’s issue tracker; all we’ll need from you are the logs (see [url=https://smapi.io/log]https://smapi.io/log[/url]).
Q: Where can I make my layout?
- Right now you can only create a layout in-game, sorry! However I'm interested in making my mod compatible with web planners. I plan to add compatibility with [url=https://stardewplan.com/]this[/url], but I don't know when yet...

[size=4][b][Special thanks]: [/b][/size]
- [b]Esca[/b] and [b]chu{e}[/b] for guidance on object rendering
- [b]tlitookilakin [/b]for some pointers in code

[size=4][b][Requirements]: [/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098][Optional] GenericModConfigMenu[/url][/color]

[color=#D4D4D8][size=4][b][Update plans]: [/b][/size][/color]
v1.0.1 - Stable release: no bugs/crashes for vanilla gameplay (no changes to original game objects)
v1.1.0 - In-game planner: mode to place objects and buildings directly into the schematic (without changing the location's contents)
v1.2.0 - API for third-party mods: a set of (de)-serialization and rendering methods, ability to create and add custom handlers
v?.?.? - Maybe something else... 🤔
